premises.text: Reply-all email threads are how business runs but are a poor collaboration substrate
premises.evidence_span: Businesses almost all run on these kind of reply all threads

premises.text: Loops are named email-addressed lists created and used through email, with a SaaS web layer for search, attachments, suggestions, and following
premises.evidence_span: The way you interact with the loop is through email

premises.text: Adoption works because no behavior change, download, or initial account is required—users stay in email
premises.evidence_span: We don't ask for anybody to download, install anything. They don't even have to create accounts at first, because it's just email

premises.text: Email-list virality supports a freemium model where paid tiers cover branding, admin, and integrations
premises.evidence_span: the thing about virality is it makes the freemium model really easy, or easier

value.text: Meet users in email and make workplace email cool and usable again
value.evidence_span: we can meet the users where they are and where they want to work, which is out of their email

secondary_value.text: Waste less time; more collaborative and social email
secondary_value.evidence_span: make email more productive, so you waste less time in it, more collaborative, and more social

notes: Truncated transcript. Demo features folded into P2. 'Make email cool again' treated as value framing aligned with primary value rather than a separate vision premise (§4.1(4)).
